published_prior_art.cite: NoackRothe2024 — honest known-cutoff bias-aware AR confidence sets, but no triangular minimax expected-length theorem.
MullerSong1997 and Tuvaandorj2020 study directly observed discontinuity localization, not connected honest fuzzy-RD LATE interval length with a weak denominator.
PorterYu2015 gives fixed-jump cutoff localization/oracle effect estimation; NoackRothe2024 gives known-cutoff weak-fuzzy honesty, neither the joint vanishing-jump unknown-cutoff regime.
ArmstrongKolesar2018 treats optimal CIs on convex regression classes; no located result evaluates this translated-cutoff causal-ratio critical-window experiment.

soundness_flags.label: def:known-cutoff-length
soundness_flags.one_line: The infimum ranges over I_n whose declared domain excludes c_P, yet the definition evaluates I_n(O_1,...,O_n;c_P); define a separate known-cutoff rule class with c_P as an input.

soundness_flags.label: ass:local-compliance-strength
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited Noack--Rothe known-cutoff conditions permit weak identification but do not state the triangular, known sequence band κ_n≤d_P≤2κ_n; retag it as a local-to-zero regime restriction and justify its role.

soundness_flags.label: ass:observable-covariance-nondegeneracy
soundness_flags.one_line: A uniform eigenvalue floor for Var(Y,D)|X is stronger than Noack--Rothe’s variance/correlation conditions and can exclude rare-treatment laws they permit; retag and justify it, or establish the frontier under their standard form.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 1
soundness_flags.one_line: The requested exact critical-window expression is said to reduce below the boundary to Theorem 2, but Theorem 2 supplies only a converse rather than a matched below-boundary frontier.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assumes i.i.d. sampling, a positive conditional outcome variance and a conditional Y,T correlation bounded away from ±1, with a continuous running-variable density bounded above and below; it does not posit κ_n≤d_P≤2κ_n or a uniform minimum eigenvalue bound for Var(Y,D)|X.

Theorem 4 gives n-consistency and an argmax limit for the unknown discontinuity estimator under a fixed-jump sharp-RD model; Theorem 5 states oracle asymptotic treatment-effect estimation after cutoff estimation.
The paper derives finite-sample optimal confidence intervals and sharp efficiency bounds for linear functionals over convex regression classes, including RD applications.
The paper studies smooth-regression change-point estimation, obtains n^-1 fixed-jump localization, and derives a two-sided Brownian limit with triangular drift under a shrinking jump.

The paper studies unknown-threshold RD/white-noise correspondences and minimax estimation results for discontinuity locations; its exact Proposition 4.2 formula was not accessible for equation-level verification.

source_verification_receipts.version: IEEE Transactions on Information Theory 68(3), 2022, pp. 1922–1944
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper treats localization of multivariate nonparametric distributional change points with unrestricted vector-valued signals, lower bounds, and a near-minimax algorithm.
LoTTA is a Bayesian approach incorporating cutoff uncertainty into RD causal-effect estimation; the accessible abstract does not claim a frequentist honest minimax connected-interval frontier.
The cited Econometrica article and bibliographic details are verified; the paper is the standard fuzzy-RD identification reference.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define L_n^known over an explicitly typed class of measurable rules (O_1,...,O_n,c)↦connected subsets of Θ, then restate the oracle comparison using that class.

Retag the local-to-zero band and joint covariance floor as deliberate regime restrictions, explain their empirical scope, and either weaken the covariance condition to Noack--Rothe’s variance/correlation form or prove how the rate changes without it.
Add a matched upper bound below T_n=o(log(1/κ_n)), or revise the OEQ’s reduction requirement to say that its lower-limit face recovers Theorem 2’s converse only.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two nonstandard assumption tags and the known-cutoff decision-rule definition, then align the all-regime critical-window claim with a genuinely matched weak-localization boundary result.
